author: Yffe
content: Found incidentally during the #204 critic audit (NOT a #204 defect; thermite-lower untouched by 8cac0ccc — same family as the #225/#230/#233/#234 chain). Repro: 'spec fn count(n: u64) -> u64 dec n { if n == 0 { 0 } else { 1 + count(n - 1) } }' -> forge check -> L0 with error[E0308]: the lowered arm '1 + count((n - 1) as u64)' is typed int against the u64 return ('expected u64, found int'). Compare conformance/sum.th spec_sum (match-form, 'head as u64 + spec_sum(t)') which certifies L3 — the if-form/int-literal shape is the gap. Fails CLOSED (no false certification), so completeness only. Also blocks any spec fn whose dec calls another spec fn from the #71 SpecFn weaving path: reachable_spec_fn_deps (body-only) drops a dec-position dep -> error[E0425] 'cannot find function ... decreases t_size(n)' -> L0 (verified live; this exposure is DOCUMENTED + sanctioned as fail-closed by proof-backends.md build-blocker (i), and the #204 obligation closure reachable_spec_fn_names_full correctly walks dec — only the sub-program WEAVING still uses the body-only closure).
